Name: HemOnc
Title: HemOnc Ontology (fragment
Used: Fragment of the HemOnc ontology, sufficient to support the Carboplatin + Paclitaxel Variant #83 example used in the Phase 0 spike, plus the mFOLFOX6 concepts referenced by the Selection Layer example. The full CodeSystem will be emitted as content=complete from the OMOP concept_stage table in a later phase.

Name: RegimenModificationKind
Title: Regimen Modification Kind
Description: Kinds of delta a derived (L2) PlanDefinition applies against its parent HemOnc variant.

Name: HemOncSigTargetType
Title: HemOnc Sig Dose Target Type
Description: Small code system distinguishing the *target* expressed by a Sig's doseQuantity from the *computed* mg dose. Used as ActivityDefinition.dosage.doseAndRate.type. A target requires a CQL helper to convert into an administered mg quantity at $apply time.
